text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto has won against T.M. Opera O in the Satsuki Sho, spring Tenno Sho, and four other G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But something is off. She's won way too many times. Could this all be a dream where she's switched places with the Overlord?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fervent praise she's receiving from everyone only further strengthens her suspicions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this is not a dream. Her talents have certified her as a piece of living history.
